convert_csv_to_xlsx.description: Converts a CSV file, uploaded or from a public URL, to an Excel XLSX workbook, with options for the header row, delimiter, locale and column mappings.
convert_csv_to_xlsx.name: convert_csv_to_xlsx

parameters.description: Dictionary of parameters to rename headers and specify types for columns, where key is the header or the index of the column in the CSV. Example: {"Header1": {"Header": "NewHeader1", "Type": "Text"}, "3": {"Type": "TwoDecimal"}} Column types: General, Text, Integer, TwoDecimal, ThousandInteger, ThousandTwoDecimal, IntegerPercentage,TwoDecimalPercentage, Scientific, ShortDate, ShortDateTime, LongDate
parameters.name: mappings

convert_doc_to_docx.description: Converts an older Word DOC file, uploaded or from a public URL, to the newer DOCX format. Returns a link to the new file.
convert_doc_to_docx.name: convert_doc_to_docx

convert_docx_to_pdf.description: Converts a Word DOCX file, uploaded or from a public URL, to PDF. Returns a link to the PDF.
convert_docx_to_pdf.name: convert_docx_to_pdf

convert_html_to_pdf.description: Converts an HTML file, uploaded or from a public URL, to PDF with the page size, orientation and margins you choose. Returns a link to the PDF.
convert_html_to_pdf.name: convert_html_to_pdf

convert_pdf_to_text.description: Extracts the text from a PDF, uploaded or from a public URL, as plain text or HTML, optionally for a range of pages or with a password.
convert_pdf_to_text.name: convert_pdf_to_text

convert_ppt_to_pptx.description: Converts an older PowerPoint PPT file, uploaded or from a public URL, to the newer PPTX format. Returns a link to the new file.
convert_ppt_to_pptx.name: convert_ppt_to_pptx

convert_pptx_to_pdf.description: Converts a PowerPoint PPTX file, uploaded or from a public URL, to PDF. Returns a link to the PDF.
convert_pptx_to_pdf.name: convert_pptx_to_pdf

convert_xls_to_xlsx.description: Converts an older Excel XLS file, uploaded or from a public URL, to the newer XLSX format. Returns a link to the new file.
convert_xls_to_xlsx.name: convert_xls_to_xlsx

convert_xlsx_to_pdf.description: Converts an Excel XLSX file, uploaded or from a public URL, to PDF. Returns a link to the PDF.
convert_xlsx_to_pdf.name: convert_xlsx_to_pdf

generate_docx.description: Fills a Word DOCX template, uploaded or from a public URL, with the data you give. Returns a link to the finished document, as DOCX or PDF.
generate_docx.name: generate_docx

generate_html.description: Fills an HTML template, uploaded or from a public URL, with the data you give. Returns a link to the finished HTML file.
generate_html.name: generate_html

generate_pptx.description: Fills a PowerPoint PPTX template, uploaded or from a public URL, with the data you give. Returns a link to the finished presentation, as PPTX or PDF.
generate_pptx.name: generate_pptx

generate_xlsx.description: Fills an Excel XLSX template, uploaded or from a public URL, with the data you give. Returns a link to the finished workbook, as XLSX or PDF.
generate_xlsx.name: generate_xlsx

get_profile.description: Gets the connected Plumsail account's profile, including the short user ID needed to start a process.
get_profile.name: get_profile

list_process_tokens.description: Lists the tokens a process's template expects, by its process ID, so you know what data to send when starting it.
list_process_tokens.name: list_process_tokens

list_processes.description: Lists the document generation processes in your Plumsail account, with each process's ID and name.
list_processes.name: list_processes

pdf_compress.description: Makes a PDF, uploaded or from a public URL, smaller, optionally without losing quality. Returns a link to the compressed PDF.
pdf_compress.name: pdf_compress

pdf_protect.description: Adds passwords to a PDF and sets whether readers may print, change, copy from or annotate it. Returns a link to the protected PDF.
pdf_protect.name: pdf_protect

pdf_split.description: Splits a PDF, uploaded or from a public URL, by extracting a page range, into chunks of a set size, or by its bookmarks. Returns links to the new files.
pdf_split.name: pdf_split

parameters.description: Page or pages range. Example: 2, 4-7, 9-*, last(3). Required for ExtractPages split type
parameters.name: extract_range

parameters.description: Number of pages in one chunk. Optional. 1 - default number of pages. Used for SplitIntoChunks split type
parameters.name: pages_in_chunk

parameters.description: Pages range. Optional. Apply to the specified pages range. E.g. 3-8. Used for SplitIntoChunks split type
parameters.name: chunks_range

parameters.description: Bookmark depth. Optional. Depth of bookmarks levels to track. 1 - default. Used for SplitByBookmarks split type
parameters.name: bookmark_depth

parameters.description: Use bookmarks as filenames. Optional. Shouldn't be "Yes" if Filename Prefix is specified. Used for SplitByBookmarks split type
parameters.name: use_bookmarks_for_file_names

parameters.description: Filename Prefix. Optional. Output files will have this prefix followed by an index number for name. Won't take effect if UseBookmarksForFileNames is "true"
parameters.name: filename_prefix

links.description: The array of link to the result files

start_process.description: Starts a document generation process by its ID with the data to fill its template, and returns links to the documents it produces.
start_process.name: start_process

description: Generate documents from templates, convert files and process PDFs.

plumsail_documents_new_process_trigger.description: Runs for each new process in Plumsail Documents. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

plumsail_documents_process_changed_trigg.description: Runs each time a process changes in Plumsail Documents. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
